name: Seated Hammer Curl
research: Seated body copied from the proven dumbbell_shoulder_press: bench 85 deg, root (0,-0.035,0.494) rot -6, feet (+-0.37,-0.58), knees pole (0.62,-1,0.9). Shoulder ~ (0.22,-0.06,0.97) world. Start elev 10 / plane 10, elbow 5: hand x = 0.22 + 0.6 sin10 cos10 = 0.32, z = 0.97 - 0.59 = 0.38, so the neutral dumbbell (plates along Y, r 0.088) spans x 0.23-0.41: clear of the seat (half-width 0.15) and the thigh root (~0.20). Neutral axis [0,1,0] = thumbs forward. End elev 15 / plane 15 (<= 10 deg elbow drift), elbow 125 folding forward (bend [0,1,0]). Thumb turns with the forearm: [0,1,0] rotated 125 deg about X in the down->forward sense = (0, cos125, sin125) = [0, -0.57, 0.82] (thumb up and back). S1 Coratella 2023 (neutral vs supinated EMG, arm parallel to trunk), S2 Oliveira 2009 (curl range).
